issue.title: [Bug]: test_vs_chassis_setup.py should not run and fail on non vs_chassis topologies

failure.body:
### Issue Description

Test runs on T2 non vs_chassis when it should only run on vs_chassis

### Results you see

Test runs on T2 non vs_chassis and fails

### Results you expected to see

Test skip on T2 non vs_chassis

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
=========================== short test summary info ============================
FAILED test_vs_chassis_setup.py::test_midplane - KeyError: 'vs_chassis'
FAILED test_vs_chassis_setup.py::test_chassisdb - KeyError: 'vs_chassis'
================== 2 failed, 2 warnings in 193.37s (<IPV6>) ===================
```

```shell

```
